clinician.trajectory_summary: A 37-year-old female presented with 4 months of dyspnea and back pain. An initial chest CT revealed near-complete right upper lobe collapse, right upper lobe consolidation, and enlarged subcarinal and station 6 lymph nodes. She was initially treated for pneumonia. A transthoracic right upper lobe biopsy showed dense fibrous pleural bits, interstitial fibrosis, and patchy lymphocytic infiltrate, with no malignant cells. Subsequent bronchoscopy with endobronchial ultrasound and BAL cytology showed poorly differentiated neoplastic cells, but material was insufficient for immunostains. A CT of the abdomen and pelvis revealed a single 15-mm hypodense liver nodule. A fluoroscopy-guided liver biopsy of this nodule demonstrated a malignant undifferentiated neoplasm with epithelioid morphology and weak neuroendocrine differentiation. Immunohistochemistry showed weak reactivity for synaptophysin, membranous CD99, positive GATA-3, weakly positive PAX-8, and negativity for many other markers. Further specialized immunohistochemical stains revealed tumor cells reactive to MUC4 expression, preserved nuclear staining for BRG1 and INI1, and negativity for claudin-4, ERG, CD31, CAMTA1, P40, ETV-4, and NUT. Based on these findings, a diagnosis of sclerosing epithelioid fibrosarcoma was concluded.

key_supporting_evidence.claim: Initial chest CT showed near-complete right upper lobe collapse, right upper lobe consolidation, enlarged subcarinal lymph node, and enlarged station 6 lymph node.
Bronchoscopy with BAL cytology was positive for poorly differentiated neoplastic cells, but material was insufficient for immunostains.
CT of the abdomen and pelvis revealed a single 15-mm hypodense nodule on the liver.
Fluoroscopy-guided liver biopsy demonstrated a malignant undifferentiated neoplasm with epithelioid morphology and weak neuroendocrine differentiation.

Immunohistochemistry from the liver biopsy showed reactivity to MUC4 expression, preserved nuclear staining for BRG1 and INI1, and negativity for numerous other markers, leading to the diagnosis of sclerosing epithelioid fibrosarcoma.
